import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import requests
import stripe
stripe.api_key = os.environ['STRIPE_SECRET_KEY']
PRINT_URL = 'https://api.bindery-print.com/v1/orders'
UNIT_CENTS = 1499
SPOOL_DIR = Path(os.environ.get('NOTEBOOK_SPOOL_DIR', 'print_spool'))

def _spool_manuscript(notes_markdown, payment_id):
    # Stage the manuscript in the pending spool folder while the print order is placed
    pending = SPOOL_DIR / 'pending' / f'{payment_id}.md'
    pending.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pending.write_text(notes_markdown, encoding='utf-8')
    return pending

def _move_to_submitted(pending, print_order_id):
    # Move the staged manuscript into the submitted folder, renamed by print order id
    dest = SPOOL_DIR / 'submitted' / f'{print_order_id or pending.stem}.md'
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(pending), str(dest))
    return str(dest)

def order_printed_notebook(customer_id, notes_markdown, shipping_address, copies=1):
    n = max(1, int(copies))
    amt = UNIT_CENTS * n
    pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amt, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, description=f'Printed notebook x{n}')
    if pi.status != 'succeeded':
        return {'ok': False, 'error': f'payment {pi.status}'}
    pending = _spool_manuscript(notes_markdown, pi.id)
    body = {'format': 'a5_hardcover', 'copies': n, 'content_markdown': notes_markdown, 'ship_to': shipping_address, 'external_ref': pi.id}
    h = {'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['BINDERY_API_KEY']}"}
    r = requests.post(PRINT_URL, json=body, headers=h, timeout=30)
    r.raise_for_status()
    d = r.json()
    manuscript_path = _move_to_submitted(pending, d.get('id'))
    return {'ok': True, 'payment_id': pi.id, 'charged_cents': amt, 'print_order_id': d.get('id'), 'manuscript_path': manuscript_path}
